name: E2E suite direct run
command: nix develop --command bash -c 'docker compose -f tests/e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose -f tests/e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml up --build --force-recreate --renew-anon-volumes --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from e2e-playwright && make clean-e2e'
